analysis.reason: 3거래일 연속 관망 판독 지속. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출했으나 여전히 50 이하 중립 구간에 머물고 있고, MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 여전히 음수 구간에서 약세 수렴 중. 거래량은 5일 평균 대비 0.44배로 위축되어 방향성 확인에 대한 신뢰도가 낮음. 52주 위치 51.6%로 중립 구간에 위치하며, 주봉 ADX 41.3으로 뚜렷한 추세가 존재하나 일봉상으로는 방향성 부재. 4시간봉 RSI 44.2로 일봉과 유사한 중립 구간. 따라서 현재 구간은 명확한 방향성 없이 축적 구간으로 판단, 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for 3 consecutive trading days. While RSI has exited oversold territory, it remains below 50 in the neutral zone. MACD histogram shows improvement but is still in negative territory with weak convergence. Trading volume is at 0.44x the 5-day average, indicating low confidence in directional confirmation. The 52-week position at 51.6% is in the neutral range. Weekly ADX at 41.3 indicates a clear trend, but daily directionality is absent. The 4-hour RSI at 44.2 is also in a neutral zone, similar to the daily chart. Therefore, the current phase is judged as an accumulation zone without clear directionality, warranting a continued wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 98,900) vs SMA5/20/50 (KRW 102,291/105,586/122,546) — Below short-term SMA5/20, below mid-term SMA50, indicating a weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 109,738)/SMA200 (KRW 87,689) — Above long-term SMA200 but below SMA100, showing mixed signals.
· 52-week position (51.6%) + Entering the historical mid-range at the current price level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.8 → 43.1) — Exiting oversold territory and entering the neutral zone, with weakening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2398.6927 → 326.4744) — Showing improvement in negative territory with continued weak convergence, trend reversal signal is still weak.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band KRW 105,586) — Sideways movement around the mid-band, indicating lack of directionality.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (KRW 82,710) — Based on 52-week low and Pivot S2.
· Swing resistance level (KRW 126,140) — Based on 52-week high and Pivot R2; a break above could signal a bullish reversal.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) — Recovery signal, suggesting potential trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.44x) — Below the 5-day average, indicating reduced confidence in the movement's reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) — No clear directionality, maintaining a wait-and-see condition due to subdued volume.
